title: Indonesian students protest rising prices, government’s handling of forest fires
paragraphs: Indonesian students protest rising prices, government’s handling of forest fires
Protesters flocked to two of Jakarta’s busiest thoroughfares, carrying banners critical of President Prabowo Subianto’s policies.
JAKARTA: Hundreds of Indonesian students took to the streets on Wednesday (Oct 28) to protest rising prices, dwindling subsidies as well as the government’s handling of forest fires.
